name: Rahman Rahman Huq (KPMG in Bangladesh)
specialty: KPMG member firm; Rahman Rahman Huq is a registered partnership firm, with KPMG Advisory Services Limited alongside it.
applicationPath: Contact through the KPMG Bangladesh site.
notes: No stated startup or SME focus. Big-four scale generally means big-four pricing — ask for scope and fee in writing first.

name: Hoda Vasi Chowdhury & Co
specialty: Foreign direct investment guidance and international assignments; a USAID-approved audit firm since 1993.
notes: Dhaka-based, states over 200 professionals. Relevant if you need donor-project or FDI-facing audit work.

name: ACNABIN
specialty: Independent member firm of Baker Tilly International.
notes: Company formation and secretarial work is not listed among its published services — confirm before engaging for registration work.

name: Snehasish Mahmud & Co
specialty: States it helps international businesses expand into Bangladesh; independent member of DFK International.
notes: The stated foreign-entry focus makes this one worth a call if you are setting up a Bangladesh entity for an overseas parent.

name: A. Qasem & Co
specialty: Member firm of ECOVIS International; established 1953.
priceModel: Not publicly stated; the site offers a request-a-quote route.
applicationPath: Request services through the firm's quote page.
notes: One of the oldest accountancy firms in the country. Its Tax and Company Affairs line covers company-related legal work as well as tax.

name: MABS & J Partners
specialty: Member firm of Nexia International, UK.
notes: One of the few on this list that publishes company secretarial and payroll outsourcing as named service lines — useful once you have staff on the books.

name: The Legal Circle
specialty: Describes itself as a full-service firm and names startups among the client types it serves.
notes: Named startup work is unusual among Dhaka firms. The site is thin on detail, so confirm the specific practice area you need.

name: FM Associates
specialty: Barristers, advocates and legal consultants serving local and multinational clients; offices in Dhaka and Chittagong.
applicationPath: Request a consultation through the firm's site.
notes: Lists 24+ practice areas including joint venture structuring and company incorporation guidance.

name: Rahman's Chambers
specialty: Nine practice departments, with long-standing recognition in shipping and maritime; five branches nationwide.
priceModel: Not publicly stated; the site refers to reasonable pricing without giving rates.
notes: Has a named information technology practice, which is rarer than it should be among Dhaka firms.
